prompt: Rule 1 is `allow tcp 10.0.0.0/8 any 22-80`. Which later rules does it shadow completely? Select all that apply.
explain: The first and last are narrower in network and ports with the same protocol. The second reaches port 443, past 80, so some of its packets are not covered. The third has protocol `any`, wider than `tcp`, so it also matches UDP packets rule 1 never sees.
